title: EditStair Command
description: Change a stair and rebuild its solid in place: width (the side against a wall stays put), riser_max (step height), going, rise (a number, or auto to follow the walls), flip (the same footprint climbed the other way). The risers re-plan, all equal. Id omitted uses the picked stair, else the only one.

id.description: The stair's GUID or its forsk:id (S01).
